English.Char_Desc_2000:
Syscalculator 1.74 RC1 is a legacy VB6 maintenance release of the classic Eurocalculator and converter tool. After 20 years, this release updates the old 1.x line with 21 euro legacy currency converters, including recent euro adoptions such as Croatia 2023 and Bulgaria 2026.
This release fixes startup and configuration problems that prevented Syscalculator from working properly on Windows 7 and later. It has also been tested on Windows 11 and appears to work correctly after the fixes. The Visual Basic 6 Runtime is still required; the installer checks for msvbvm60.dll and offers to open the official Microsoft runtime download page when it is missing.
WizardExpress remains available for older Office, Word, Excel, Access, WordPerfect, StarOffice and LibreOffice workflows. LibreOffice has been tested and works ok. Microsoft 365 / Office 365 is not supported reliably with this old VB6 integration.
Syscalculator 1.74 RC1 is planned as the final Syscalculator 1.x legacy release before the new Syscalculator 2.0 line, built with modern .NET technology and new features that the old 1.7x line does not have.
